subject: Scales with facet_wrap - fixed by row?

messages.author: 7c1e3896b587548f
messages.subject: Scales with facet_wrap - fixed by row?
parts:
This is my first experience creating ggplot2 graphics on my own, so
sorry in advance if this is covered elsewhere - I couldn't find it.
I've used facet_wrap() to create a 3x2 figure; each row represents a
specific portion of the brain, and each column represents a time
point. Ideally, I would like to have the Y limits fixed within each
row, but vary between the rows. Is there any way to do this? I could
create three separate figures, but we would really like to keep it to
one with six panels.

Thanks!

messages.author: 4e69b94a09c8cf3b
messages.subject: Re: Scales with facet_wrap - fixed by row?
parts:
Does

facet_grid(brainpor ~ time, scales= "free_y")

do what you need?
